prompts.text: It was unlike any place I’d ever been.

prompts.text: He leaned forward and said …

prompts.title: Across the street

prompts.title: The cold room
prompts.text: The room was surprisingly cold.

prompts.title: The mission
prompts.text: I had 30 minutes to complete the mission.

prompts.title: Keep going
prompts.text: Although I was nervous, I decided to continue.

prompts.title: A mysterious package
prompts.text: A package arrived with no address, no stamp, and a key taped to the top.

prompts.title: A box for the future
prompts.text: Imagine you could fill a box for someone to open one hundred years from now. What would you put inside, and what would your choices show that person about life today?

prompts.title: The wrong door
prompts.text: The door opened before I had a chance to knock.

prompts.title: Learning something difficult
prompts.text: Describe a time you struggled to learn something new. What helped you keep trying, and what did the experience teach you?

prompts.title: The unexpected message
prompts.text: The message was only six words long, but it changed our plans.

prompts.title: A small act of kindness
prompts.text: Describe a small act of kindness that made a difference to you or someone else. Explain why it mattered.

prompts.title: The missing piece
prompts.text: Everyone was ready to begin when we noticed something was missing.

prompts.title: A place that matters
prompts.text: Choose a place that is meaningful to you. Use specific details to explain what makes it special and how you feel when you are there.

prompts.title: A different point of view
prompts.text: From up here, the town looked completely different.

prompts.title: Changing your mind
prompts.text: Describe a time you changed your mind about a person, activity, or idea. What caused the change, and what did you learn?

prompts.title: The promise
prompts.text: I had made a promise, and now I had to decide how to keep it.

prompts.title: Someone you admire
prompts.text: Describe a quality you admire in someone you know. Give a specific example of that quality in action and explain why it matters to you.

prompts.title: The last chance
prompts.text: There was still one way to solve the problem, but we would have to work together.

prompts.title: An unexpected lesson
prompts.text: Describe something you learned outside a classroom. Explain how you learned it and why the lesson has stayed with you.

checklist.title: I answered the chosen prompt.
checklist.detail: For a story, use the supplied opening sentence. For a personal response, address each part of the question.

checklist.title: My writing has a clear focus.
checklist.detail: A story follows a character facing a clear challenge. A personal response develops one main point.

checklist.title: I used specific details.
checklist.detail: Replace vague statements with an action, image, example, or moment the reader can picture.

checklist.title: My ideas connect in a sensible order.
checklist.detail: Give the reader a clear beginning, a developed middle, and an ending. Start new paragraphs when the focus changes.

checklist.title: My sentences sound clear and natural.
checklist.detail: Use precise words and vary sentence openings. Prefer a word you understand to an unfamiliar one.

checklist.title: I checked my final draft.
checklist.detail: Look for missing words, run-on sentences, capitalization, punctuation, and spelling. Read the ending one more time.
